sources: Original Filipino recipes written by Bantay. The plate idea follows Pinggang Pinoy (FNRI-DOST) and the DASH eating plan (NHLBI). Sodium is a rough estimate worked out by Bantay from typical food values, with USDA FoodData Central as the guide. It is not a lab result and a dietitian has not checked it. Brands differ a lot, so read the label. Each ingredient line carries its sodium in mg for the whole pot.

recipes.name: Sinigang na isda, less patis
ingredients: Instead of a ready-made sinigang mix, which is salty
Add calamansi to keep the taste
steps: Boil 6 cups of water with the onion and tomato. Add the tamarind juice.
Add the radish and string beans. Cook 8 minutes.
Add the fish. Simmer 6 minutes, then add 1 tsp patis.
Add the kangkong last. Taste before adding more salt.

recipes.name: Ginisang monggo with malunggay
ingredients: Add at the end so they stay green
Or skip it and use more beans
Do not add more at the table
steps: Boil the monggo in 4 cups of water until soft, about 25 minutes.
Fry the garlic, onion, tomato and pork in a little oil until the pork is cooked.
Add the cooked monggo and its water. Simmer 5 minutes.
Add 1 tsp patis and the malunggay. Cook 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.name: Pinakbet light
ingredients: Usual recipes use 3 tsp or more
steps: Fry the garlic, onion and tomato in a little oil.
Add 1 tsp bagoong and half a cup of water. Bring to a boil.
Add the kalabasa and sitaw. Cover and cook 8 minutes. Do not stir much.
Add the talong, okra and ampalaya. Cook 5 minutes more until just soft.

recipes.name: Tinolang manok, less patis
steps: Fry the ginger and onion in a little oil. Add the chicken and fry 3 minutes.
Add 5 cups of water and the patis. Bring to a boil, then simmer.
Simmer 20 minutes. Add the papaya.
Cook 8 minutes more until the papaya is soft.
Add the leaves, turn off the heat and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken adobo, low salt
steps: Put the chicken, garlic, pepper, bay leaf, vinegar and soy sauce in a pot. Do not stir yet.
Add half a cup of water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer, covered, for 25 minutes.
Uncover and cook 8 more minutes until the sauce is thick.
Serve with a small scoop of brown rice and a plate of vegetables.

recipes.name: Ginataang kalabasa at sitaw
recipes.blurb: Squash and beans in light coconut milk
steps: Fry the garlic, onion and ginger in a little oil.
Add the kalabasa, coconut milk and half a cup of water. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add the sitaw. Cook 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp and patis. Cook 3 minutes until pink.

recipes.name: Escabeche, sweet and sour fish
recipes.blurb: Fried fish in light vinegar sauce
ingredients: Quarter cup vinegar and 1 tsp sugar
A pinch of salt, about one eighth of a teaspoon
steps: Pat the fish dry. Fry it in a little oil until golden. Set aside.
Fry the garlic, onion and ginger. Add the carrot and bell pepper.
Add the vinegar, sugar, salt and half a cup of water. Simmer 5 minutes.
Pour the sauce over the fish. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Paksiw na isda
recipes.blurb: Fish cooked in vinegar and ginger
ingredients: Thumb of ginger and 4 cloves garlic
Half an ampalaya and 2 siling haba
steps: Lay the ginger, garlic and ampalaya in a pot. Place the fish on top.
Add the vinegar, half a cup of water, patis and the chili. Do not stir.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with the sauce spooned over.

recipes.name: Pesang isda
steps: Boil 5 cups of water with the ginger, onion and tomato.
Add the fish. Simmer 8 minutes.
Add the patis. Taste the soup first, it may be enough.
Add the pechay and cook 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Inihaw na bangus with tomato
recipes.blurb: Grilled milkfish with tomato and onion
steps: Mix the tomato, onion, ginger, calamansi juice and pepper.
Stuff the mixture inside the fish. Wrap each fish in foil.
Grill or bake over medium heat, 12 minutes on each side.
Open the foil and serve with cucumber slices.

recipes.name: Ensaladang talong
steps: Grill the eggplants over a flame until the skin is black and soft, about 10 minutes.
Peel off the skin. Slice the flesh.
Mix the tomato, onion, vinegar, calamansi and patis.
Pour over the eggplant. Serve cool.

recipes.name: Ginisang ampalaya with egg
ingredients: Soak in cold water 10 minutes to be less bitter
steps: Fry the garlic, onion and tomato in a little oil.
Add the ampalaya. Cook 5 minutes, stirring.
Add the patis. Pour in the beaten eggs.
Stir gently until the egg is set. Serve with a small portion of rice.

recipes.name: Nilagang baka, light
steps: Boil the beef with the onion and peppercorns in 8 cups of water. Simmer until tender, about 60 minutes. Skim the foam.
Add the potato and corn. Cook 15 minutes.
Add the patis and cabbage. Cook 5 minutes.
Add the pechay last. Turn off the heat and serve.

recipes.name: Arroz caldo, soft and light
ingredients: Add calamansi at the table, not patis
steps: Fry the garlic, onion and ginger. Add the chicken and rice.
Add 7 cups of water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer 30 minutes, stirring often, until very soft.
Add the patis. Top with the egg and a squeeze of calamansi.

recipes.name: Tokwa and pechay stir-fry
steps: Pan-fry the tofu cubes in a little oil until light gold. Set aside.
Fry the garlic and onion. Add the carrot and cook 3 minutes.
Add the pechay and soy sauce. Cook 3 minutes.
Return the tofu. Stir and serve.

recipes.name: Sopas, light
ingredients: 1 carrot and half a cup of cabbage
steps: Boil the chicken in 6 cups of water for 15 minutes. Shred it.
Fry the onion and celery. Add the carrot and the chicken broth.
Add the macaroni and cook 10 minutes.
Add the chicken, cabbage, milk and patis. Warm gently and serve.

recipes.name: Kalabasa soup
ingredients: Half a cup light coconut milk
A pinch of salt, about one eighth of a teaspoon
steps: Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil.
Add the kalabasa and 4 cups of water. Simmer until very soft, about 20 minutes.
Mash or blend until smooth.
Stir in the coconut milk, salt and pepper. Warm and serve.

recipes.name: Steamed fish with ginger
ingredients: Thumb of ginger and 2 spring onions
steps: Lay half of the ginger in a heatproof plate. Put the fish on top.
Pour the soy sauce and calamansi over the fish.
Steam over boiling water for 12 minutes.
Top with the rest of the ginger and the spring onion. Serve with steamed vegetables.

recipes.name: Ginisang repolyo with chicken
steps: Fry the garlic and onion. Add the chicken and cook until white.
Add the carrot and cook 3 minutes.
Add the cabbage and patis. Cook 4 minutes, still a little crunchy.
Serve with a small scoop of brown rice.

recipes.name: Ginisang sayote with shrimp
steps: Fry the garlic, onion and tomato in a little oil.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2 minutes.
Add the sayote, patis and a quarter cup of water. Cover and cook 8 minutes.
Taste. Add calamansi instead of more patis.
